name: Happy Path — General DOL knowledge (no ID&V)

x_eval.persona: New caller with a general question about DOL services.
x_eval.goal: Learn what the Department of Labor help line can assist with. Done when the agent answers from knowledge with at least one concrete service area (appointments, unemployment, offices, etc.).

turns.text: What kinds of things can you help me with at the Department of Labor?

turns.note: Ask one follow-up if the answer was vague.

rubric.assertion: The agent described at least one DOL service the virtual front door can help with.
The agent invoked search_dol_knowledge for the general question.
The agent did not request identity verification for this general information question.
The answer was summarized in plain language, not a long verbatim article.
